answer: Fingerprint escrow blocks bulk sybil farms. A new agent locks 200 POA and must hold a stable fingerprint, its atlas of counterparties, timing and task mix, for 30 days to unlock it. Random checkpoints sample it; a mismatch freezes it. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 200 = 200,000 POA locked a month, while an honest agent pays 200 POA once and gets it back. The jade test: real work leaves a fingerprint no ivory-tower fake can copy cheaply.
